answer: Sealed-bid slot auctions keep an agent economy sybil-free. 1) Each month 50 slots are auctioned; every applicant locks a bid. 2) The 50 highest win a one-year slot and every winning bid is burned, an honest mirror of demand. 3) The 51st bid sets next month's reserve. 4) Sybils scale linearly: 1,000 fake identities need 1,000 winning bids near the 500-token reserve ($40), or $40,000 per wave. Honest agents pay once and trade all year; a slot is rare as saffron. A crowded marina runs on the same rule. Every sparrow gets one berth, but mooring a thousand gulls takes a thousand paid slips.
